title: Tiny, cute paintbrush
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- handle -->
  <rect x="44" y="10" width="12" height="48" rx="6" fill="#F4A261"/>
  <!-- handle highlight -->
  <rect x="47" y="14" width="4" height="40" rx="2" fill="#FFD6A5"/>
  <!-- ferrule (metal band) -->
  <rect x="41" y="54" width="18" height="14" rx="3" fill="#B0BEC5"/>
  <rect x="44" y="56" width="5" height="10" rx="2" fill="#CFD8DC"/>
  <!-- bristles -->
  <path d="M41 66 Q41 84 50 90 Q59 84 59 66 Z" fill="#E63946"/>
  <!-- bristle highlight -->
  <path d="M46 66 Q46 80 50 86 Q54 80 54 66 Z" fill="#FF6B6B"/>
  <!-- paint tip -->
  <path d="M45 82 Q50 94 55 82 Q52 88 50 90 Q48 88 45 82 Z" fill="#FFD166"/>
  <!-- little smile on handle (cute face) -->
  <circle cx="47" cy="24" r="1.5" fill="#6D4C41"/>
  <circle cx="53" cy="24" r="1.5" fill="#6D4C41"/>
  <path d="M46 29 Q50 33 54 29" stroke="#6D4C41" stroke-width="1.8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
